passages.text: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
passages.sermon:
Israel was also called Jacob.
Israel had twelve sons.
Their names were Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
Their names were also Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רְאוּבֵ֤ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ לֵוִ֣י וִיהוּדָ֔ה יִשָׂשכָ֖ר וּזְבֻלֽוּן׃ דָּ֚ן יוֹסֵ֣ף וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן נַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְאָשֵֽׁר׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, who put him to death.
passages.sermon:
Judah was a son of Israel.
Judah had three sons.
Their names were Er, Onan, and Shelah.
Bath-shua was their mother.
Bath-shua was a Canaanite woman.
Er was Judah’s firstborn son.
Er did what was wicked in the sight of the LORD.
The LORD put Er to death.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֤ר וְאוֹנָן֙ וְשֵׁלָ֔ה שְׁלוֹשָׁה֙ נ֣וֹלַד ל֔וֹ מִבַּת־ שׁ֖וּעַ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑ית וַיְהִ֞י עֵ֣ר׀ בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֗ה רַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיְמִיתֵֽהוּ׃ס

passages.text: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
passages.sermon:
Judah was the son of Israel.
Tamar was Judah’s daughter-in-law.
Tamar gave birth to Perez for Judah.
Tamar also gave birth to Zerah for Judah.
Judah had five sons in total.
passages.original: וְתָמָר֙ כַּלָּת֔וֹ יָ֥לְדָה לּ֖וֹ אֶת־ פֶּ֣רֶץ וְאֶת־ זָ֑רַח כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
passages.sermon: Perez was a son of Judah.\r\nPerez had two sons.\r\nTheir names were Hezron and Hamul.
passages.original: בְּנֵי־ פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְחָמֽוּל׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara —five in all.
passages.sermon: Zerah was a son of Judah.\r\nZerah had five sons.\r\nTheir names were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י זֶ֗רַח זִ֠מְרִי וְאֵיתָ֧ן וְהֵימָ֛ן וְכַלְכֹּ֥ל וָדָ֖רַע כֻּלָּ֥ם חֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
passages.sermon: Carmi had a son named Achar.\r\nAchar brought trouble to Israel.\r\nAchar violated the ban on devoted things.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י כַּרְמִ֑י עָכָר֙ עוֹכֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָעַ֖ל בַּחֵֽרֶם׃ס

passages.text: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
passages.sermon: Ethan had a son.\r\nHis son was Azariah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אֵיתָ֖ן עֲזַרְיָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
passages.sermon: Hezron was a man in Israel’s history.\r\nHezron had sons.\r\nHezron’s sons were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י חֶצְר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נוֹלַד־ ל֑וֹ אֶת־ יְרַחְמְאֵ֥ל וְאֶת־ רָ֖ם וְאֶת־ כְּלוּבָֽי׃

passages.text: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
passages.sermon: Ram was the father of Amminadab.\r\nAmminadab was the father of Nahshon.\r\nNahshon was a leader of the descendants of Judah.
passages.original: וְרָ֖ם הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ עַמִּינָדָ֑ב וְעַמִּינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ נַחְשׁ֔וֹן נְשִׂ֖יא בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
passages.sermon: Nahshon was a man in the family line of Judah.\r\nNahshon had a son named Salmon.\r\nSalmon had a son named Boaz.
passages.original: וְנַחְשׁוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שַׂלְמָ֔א וְשַׂלְמָ֖א הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ בֹּֽעַז׃

passages.text: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
passages.sermon: Boaz was the father of Obed.\r\nObed was the father of Jesse.
passages.original: וּבֹ֙עַז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ עוֹבֵ֔ד וְעוֹבֵ֖ד הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יִשָֽׁי׃

passages.text: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third, Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth, Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
passages.sermon:
Jesse was the father of seven sons.
Eliab was Jesse’s first son.
Abinadab was Jesse’s second son.
Shimea was Jesse’s third son.
Nethanel was Jesse’s fourth son.
Raddai was Jesse’s fifth son.
Ozem was Jesse’s sixth son.
David was Jesse’s seventh son.
passages.original: וְאִישַׁ֛י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ בְּכֹר֖וֹ אֶת־ אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַאֲבִינָדָב֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְשִׁמְעָ֖א הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃ נְתַנְאֵל֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י רַדַּ֖י הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ אֹ֚צֶם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י דָּוִ֖יד הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃

passages.text: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
passages.sermon:
Jesse had two daughters.
Their names were Zeruiah and Abigail.
Zeruiah had three sons.
Their names were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
passages.original: וְאַחְיֹתֵיהֶם צְרוּיָ֣ה וַאֲבִיגָ֑יִל וּבְנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֗ה אַבְשַׁ֛י וְיוֹאָ֥ב וַעֲשָׂה־ אֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
passages.sermon: Abigail was the mother of Amasa.\r\nJether the Ishmaelite was the father of Amasa.
passages.original: וַאֲבִיגַ֕יִל יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־ עֲמָשָׂ֑א וַאֲבִ֣י עֲמָשָׂ֔א יֶ֖תֶר הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִֽי׃

passages.text: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Hezron.
Caleb had a wife named Azubah.
Caleb also had a wife named Jerioth.
Azubah had three sons.
Their names were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
passages.original: וְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־ חֶצְר֗וֹן הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־ עֲזוּבָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ יְרִיע֑וֹת וְאֵ֣לֶּה בָנֶ֔יהָ יֵ֥שֶׁר וְשׁוֹבָ֖ב וְאַרְדּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
passages.sermon:
Azubah was Caleb’s wife.
Azubah died.
Caleb married Ephrath.
Ephrath gave birth to Hur.
Hur was the son of Caleb and Ephrath.
passages.original: וַתָּ֖מָת עֲזוּבָ֑ה וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֤וֹ כָלֵב֙ אֶת־ אֶפְרָ֔ת וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־ חֽוּר׃

passages.text: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
passages.sermon: Hur was the father of Uri.\r\nUri was the father of Bezalel.
passages.original: וְחוּר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אוּרִ֔י וְאוּרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ בְּצַלְאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
passages.sermon:
Hezron was a descendant of Judah.
Machir was the father of Gilead.
Hezron married the daughter of Machir.
Hezron was sixty years old when he married her.
She gave birth to a son.
They named their son Segub.
passages.original: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֤א חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֶל־ בַּת־ מָכִיר֙ אֲבִ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וְה֣וּא לְקָחָ֔הּ וְה֖וּא בֶּן־ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־ שְׂגֽוּב׃

passages.text: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
passages.sermon: Segub was the father of Jair.\r\nJair had twenty-three cities.\r\nThese cities were in the land of Gilead.
passages.original: וּשְׂג֖וּב הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יָאִ֑יר וַֽיְהִי־ ל֗וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְשָׁלוֹשׁ֙ עָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
passages.sermon:
Geshur and Aram were two groups of people.
They took Havvoth-jair from the descendants of Machir.
They also took Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages.
All these places belonged to the descendants of Machir.
Machir was the father of Gilead.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח גְּשֽׁוּר־ וַ֠אֲרָם אֶת־ חַוֺּ֨ת יָאִ֧יר מֵאִתָּ֛ם אֶת־ קְנָ֥ת וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים עִ֑יר כָּל־ אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֖י מָכִ֥יר אֲבִי־ גִלְעָֽד׃

passages.text: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
passages.sermon:
Hezron was a man.
Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah.
Hezron had a wife named Abijah.
After Hezron died, Abijah gave birth to a son.
Abijah’s son was Ashhur.
Ashhur became the father of Tekoa.
passages.original: וְאַחַ֥ר מוֹת־ חֶצְר֖וֹן בְּכָלֵ֣ב אֶפְרָ֑תָה וְאֵ֤שֶׁת חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־ אַשְׁח֖וּר אֲבִ֥י תְקֽוֹעַ׃

passages.text: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
passages.sermon:
Jerahmeel was the firstborn son of Hezron.
Jerahmeel had several sons.
Ram was Jerahmeel’s firstborn son.
Jerahmeel’s other sons were Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֧וּ בְנֵי־ יְרַחְמְאֵ֛ל בְּכ֥וֹר חֶצְר֖וֹן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ רָ֑ם וּבוּנָ֥ה וָאֹ֛רֶן וָאֹ֖צֶם אֲחִיָּֽה׃

passages.text: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
passages.sermon:
Jerahmeel was the firstborn son of Hezron.
Jerahmeel had another wife.
Her name was Atarah.
Atarah was the mother of Onam.
passages.original: וַתְּהִ֨י אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֛רֶת לִֽירַחְמְאֵ֖ל וּשְׁמָ֣הּ עֲטָרָ֑ה הִ֖יא אֵ֥ם אוֹנָֽם׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
passages.sermon: Ram was the firstborn son of Jerahmeel.\r\nRam had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ רָ֖ם בְּכ֣וֹר יְרַחְמְאֵ֑ל מַ֥עַץ וְיָמִ֖ין וָעֵֽקֶר׃

passages.text: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
passages.sermon:
Onam had two sons.
Their names were Shammai and Jada.
Shammai had two sons.
Their names were Nadab and Abishur.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ אוֹנָ֖ם שַׁמַּ֣י וְיָדָ֑ע וּבְנֵ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִישֽׁוּר׃

passages.text: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
passages.sermon:
Abishur had a wife.
Her name was Abihail.
Abihail gave birth to two sons.
Their names were Ahban and Molid.
passages.original: וְשֵׁ֛ם אֵ֥שֶׁת אֲבִישׁ֖וּר אֲבִיהָ֑יִל וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֔וֹ אֶת־ אַחְבָּ֖ן וְאֶת־ מוֹלִֽיד׃

passages.text: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
passages.sermon:
Nadab had two sons.
Their names were Seled and Appaim.
Seled died.
Seled had no children.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב סֶ֣לֶד וְאַפָּ֑יִם וַיָּ֥מָת סֶ֖לֶד לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ס

passages.text: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
passages.sermon: Appaim had a son named Ishi.\r\nIshi had a son named Sheshan.\r\nSheshan had a son named Ahlai.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י אַפַּ֖יִם יִשְׁעִ֑י וּבְנֵ֤י יִשְׁעִי֙ שֵׁשָׁ֔ן וּבְנֵ֥י שֵׁשָׁ֖ן אַחְלָֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
passages.sermon:
Jada was the brother of Shammai.
Jada had two sons.
Their names were Jether and Jonathan.
Jether died.
Jether had no children.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֤י יָדָע֙ אֲחִ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י יֶ֖תֶר וְיוֹנָתָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מָת יֶ֖תֶר לֹ֥א בָנִֽים׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
passages.sermon: Jonathan had two sons.\r\nTheir names were Peleth and Zaza.\r\nPeleth and Zaza were descendants of Jerahmeel.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יוֹנָתָ֖ן פֶּ֣לֶת וְזָזָ֑א אֵ֥לֶּה הָי֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יְרַחְמְאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; but he did have an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
passages.sermon:
Sheshan was a man in this genealogy.
Sheshan had no sons.
Sheshan had only daughters.
Sheshan had a servant.
The servant was Egyptian.
The servant’s name was Jarha.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ הָיָ֧ה לְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־ בָּנ֑וֹת וּלְשֵׁשָׁ֛ן עֶ֥בֶד מִצְרִ֖י וּשְׁמ֥וֹ יַרְחָֽע׃

passages.text: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
passages.sermon:
Sheshan had a servant named Jarha.
Sheshan had only daughters.
Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha as a wife.
Sheshan’s daughter became Jarha’s wife.
Sheshan’s daughter gave birth to a son.
They named the son Attai.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שֵׁשָׁ֧ן אֶת־ בִּתּ֛וֹ לְיַרְחָ֥ע עַבְדּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ אֶת־ עַתָּֽי׃

passages.text: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad, Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed, Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah, Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum, Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
passages.sermon:
Attai was the father of Nathan.
Nathan was the father of Zabad.
Zabad was the father of Ephlal.
Ephlal was the father of Obed.
Obed was the father of Jehu.
Jehu was the father of Azariah.
Azariah was the father of Helez.
Helez was the father of Elasah.
Elasah was the father of Sismai.
Sismai was the father of Shallum.
Shallum was the father of Jekamiah.
Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
passages.original: וְעַתַּי֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ נָתָ֔ן וְנָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ זָבָֽד׃ וְזָבָד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אֶפְלָ֔ל וְאֶפְלָ֖ל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עוֹבֵֽד׃ וְעוֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יֵה֔וּא וְיֵה֖וּא הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עֲזַרְיָֽה׃ וַעֲזַרְיָה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ חָ֔לֶץ וְחֶ֖לֶץ הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֶלְעָשָֽׂה׃ וְאֶלְעָשָׂה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ סִֽסְמָ֔י וְסִסְמַ֖י הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ שַׁלּֽוּם׃ וְשַׁלּוּם֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יְקַמְיָ֔ה וִֽיקַמְיָ֖ה הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֱלִישָׁמָֽע׃

passages.text: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the brother of Jerahmeel.
Caleb had sons.
Mesha was Caleb’s firstborn son.
Mesha was the father of Ziph.
Mareshah was Caleb’s second son.
Mareshah was the father of Hebron.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֤י כָלֵב֙ אֲחִ֣י יְרַחְמְאֵ֔ל מֵישָׁ֥ע בְּכֹר֖וֹ ה֣וּא אֲבִי־ זִ֑יף וּבְנֵ֥י מָרֵשָׁ֖ה אֲבִ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
passages.sermon: Hebron had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן קֹ֥רַח וְתַפֻּ֖חַ וְרֶ֥קֶם וָשָֽׁמַע׃

passages.text: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
passages.sermon:
Shema was a son of Hebron.
Shema became the father of Raham.
Raham became the father of Jorkeam.
Rekem was also a son of Hebron.
Rekem became the father of Shammai.
passages.original: וְשֶׁ֣מַע הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת־ רַ֖חַם אֲבִ֣י יָרְקֳעָ֑ם וְרֶ֖קֶם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ שַׁמָּֽי׃

passages.text: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
passages.sermon: Shammai had a son named Maon.\r\nMaon was the father of Beth-zur.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ שַׁמַּ֖י מָע֑וֹן וּמָע֖וֹן אֲבִ֥י בֵֽית־ צֽוּר׃

passages.text: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
passages.sermon:
Caleb had a concubine named Ephah.
Ephah gave birth to Haran.
Ephah gave birth to Moza.
Ephah gave birth to Gazez.
Haran was the father of Gazez.
passages.original: וְעֵיפָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ כָּלֵ֔ב יָֽלְדָ֛ה אֶת־ חָרָ֥ן וְאֶת־ מוֹצָ֖א וְאֶת־ גָּזֵ֑ז וְחָרָ֖ן הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ גָּזֵֽז׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
passages.sermon: Jahdai had sons.\r\nTheir names were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יָהְדָּ֑י רֶ֧גֶם וְיוֹתָ֛ם וְגֵישָׁ֥ן וָפֶ֖לֶט וְעֵיפָ֥ה וָשָֽׁעַף׃

passages.text: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
passages.sermon: Caleb had a concubine named Maacah.\r\nMaacah gave birth to Sheber.\r\nMaacah also gave birth to Tirhanah.
passages.original: פִּלֶ֤גֶשׁ כָּלֵב֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה יָ֥לַד שֶׁ֖בֶר וְאֶֽת־ תִּרְחֲנָֽה׃

passages.text: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
passages.sermon:
Maacah was a concubine of Caleb.
Maacah gave birth to Shaaph.
Shaaph was the father of Madmannah.
Maacah also gave birth to Sheva.
Sheva was the father of Machbenah.
Sheva was also the father of Gibea.
Caleb had a daughter named Acsah.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֗לֶד שַׁ֚עַף אֲבִ֣י מַדְמַנָּ֔ה אֶת־ שְׁוָ֛א אֲבִ֥י מַכְבֵּנָ֖ה וַאֲבִ֣י גִבְעָ֑א וּבַת־ כָּלֵ֖ב עַכְסָֽה׃ס

passages.text: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim, Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Hur.
Hur was the firstborn son of Ephrathah.
Caleb had sons.
Shobal was one son of Caleb.
Shobal was the father of Kiriath-jearim.
Salma was another son of Caleb.
Salma was the father of Bethlehem.
Hareph was another son of Caleb.
Hareph was the father of Beth-gader.
These were the descendants of Caleb.
passages.original: אֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י כָלֵ֔ב בֶּן־ ח֖וּר בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֑תָה שׁוֹבָ֕ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃ שַׂלְמָא֙ אֲבִ֣י בֵֽית־ לָ֔חֶם חָרֵ֖ף אֲבִ֥י בֵית־ גָּדֵֽר׃

passages.text: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim: Haroeh, half the Manahathites, and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
passages.sermon:
Shobal was the father of Kiriath-jearim.
Shobal had sons.
One son was Haroeh.
Another group was half the Manahathites.
There were clans from Kiriath-jearim.
These clans were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites.
The Zorathites came from these clans.
The Eshtaolites also came from these clans.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ בָנִים֙ לְשׁוֹבָ֔ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים הָרֹאֶ֖ה חֲצִ֥י הַמְּנֻחֽוֹת׃ וּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת֙ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים הַיִּתְרִי֙ וְהַפּוּתִ֔י וְהַשֻּׁמָתִ֖י וְהַמִּשְׁרָעִ֑י מֵאֵ֗לֶּה יָצְאוּ֙ הַצָּ֣רְעָתִ֔י וְהָאֶשְׁתָּ֖אֻֽלִֽי׃ס

passages.text: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites, and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
passages.sermon:
Salma was an ancestor of several groups.
His descendants included Bethlehem.
His descendants included the Netophathites.
His descendants included Atroth-beth-joab.
His descendants included half of the Manahathites.
His descendants included the Zorites.
There were also clans of scribes who lived at Jabez.
These clans were the Tirathites.
These clans were the Shimeathites.
These clans were the Sucathites.
These clans were Kenites.
The Kenites came from Hammath.
Hammath was the ancestor of the house of Rechab.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י שַׂלְמָ֗א בֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ וּנְט֣וֹפָתִ֔י עַטְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יוֹאָ֑ב וַחֲצִ֥י הַמָּנַחְתִּ֖י הַצָּרְעִֽי׃ וּמִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת סֹפְרִים֙ יֹשְׁבוּ יַעְבֵּ֔ץ תִּרְעָתִ֥ים שִׁמְעָתִ֖ים שׂוּכָתִ֑ים הֵ֚מָּה הַקִּינִ֣ים הַבָּאִ֔ים מֵחַמַּ֖ת אֲבִ֥י בֵית־ רֵכָֽב׃ס
